description_en: Generates an Alibaba Cloud CLI command dynamically
kebab_example: aliyun openapiexplorer generate-cli-command --product Ecs --biz-api-version 2014-05-26 --api DescribeRegions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-params key=example-string --json-api-params InstanceChargeType_:_PostPaid_,_ResourceType_:_instance_,_AcceptLanguage_:_en-US --aggregate-pagination true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateCLICommand

parameters.description_en:
The product code. You can find it in two ways:

- Call the `GetRequestLog` operation. The product code will be included in the response data.

- The product code is the last part of the service's URL in OpenAPI Explorer. For example, <props="china">the OpenAPI Explorer URL for Short Message Service is https\://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi. Therefore, the product code is Dysmsapi.</props><props="intl">the OpenAPI Explorer URL for Short Message Service is https\://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi. Therefore, the product code is Dysmsapi.</props>
parameters.description_zh:
产品CODE。

- 调用GetRequestLog接口，从返回结果中获取产品CODE。

- 通过OpenAPI门户的URL，找到对应的产品CODE。例如，<props="china">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
<props="intl">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable aggregation. If enabled, the CLI automatically reads full data using pagination and aggregates the results.

><warning>

You can use this option only with List operations that support pagination.

></warning>

- true: Enable

- false: Disable
parameters.description_zh:
是否使用聚合能力，若开启，CLI会自动以分页的方式读取全量数据并对结果聚合。

<warning>只有支持分页的List类型的接口才能使用这个开关。</warning>

- true：开启
- false：关闭
parameters.help_en:
